abstract: STUDY OBJECTIVE: This study was undertaken to assess the indications, procedures, and pathology in premenarchal girls undergoing ovarian surgery. DESIGN: Retrospective chart review. SETTING: University of Michigan Medical Center 1980-1996. PARTICIPANTS: Premenarchal girls, who underwent ovarian surgery. INTERVENTIONS: None. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: All available charts (n = 52) had information extracted concerning age at time of surgery, presenting symptoms, preoperative and postoperative diagnosis, procedure, and pathology report. RESULTS: Of the 52 patients, 50% were less than 1 year old, 31% were between 1 and 8 years old, and 19% were between 8 and 12 years old. Presenting complaints in 31 patients included structural and or endocrinologic abnormalities, and the other 21 patients presented with abdominal or systemic complaints. The most common preoperative diagnosis was an abdominal/pelvic mass (n = 24). The postoperative diagnoses revealed 18 torsions and 16 ovarian masses without torsion, 8 chromosomal abnormalities, 5 hernias, and 5 malignancies. Procedures included 37 salpingo-oophorectomies (28 unilateral and 9 bilateral), 7 oophorectomies, and 7 cystectomies. One patient underwent a staging procedure. Pathology reports confirmed hemorrhagic infarctions (n = 19), dysgenic gonads (n = 8), simple cysts (n = 7), teratomas (n = 6), theca lutein cysts (n = 4), fibroma (n = 1), stromal tumor (n = 1), mucinous cystadenoma (n = 1), granulosa cell tumor (n = 1), uterine neuroblastoma (n = 1), mixed germ cell neoplasm (n = 1), metastatic Wilms' tumor (n = 1), and gonadoblastoma (n = 1). CONCLUSIONS: Torsion was the most common diagnosis in our study group and was usually unsuspected. Premenarchal ovarian surgery usually included removal of the entire ovary. However, because malignancies are uncommon in this population (9.6%), a cystectomy should be considered when appropriate and technically feasible.
abstract_ja: 目的:前思春期の少女で卵巣手術を受けた症例について、適応、術式、病理所見を評価すること。デザイン:後方視的診療録レビュー。設定:ミシガン大学医療センター、1980年から1996年。対象:卵巣手術を受けた前思春期の少女。介入:なし。主要評価項目:全ての利用可能な診療録(52例)から、手術時年齢、初発症状、術前・術後の診断、術式、病理報告を抽出した。結果:52例のうち、50%は1歳未満、31%は1〜8歳、19%は8〜12歳であった。31例の初発症状は構造的および/または内分泌的異常で、残り21例は腹部または全身症状であった。術前の最も多い診断は腹部/骨盤内腫瘤(24例)であった。術後診断はねじれ18例、ねじれのない卵巣腫瘤16例、染色体異常8例、ヘルニア5例、悪性腫瘍5例であった。術式は卵巣卵管摘出術37例(片側28例、両側9例)、卵巣摘出術7例、嚢腫摘出術7例であった。1例は病期分類のための手術を受けた。病理診断では、出血性梗塞19例、異形成性性腺8例、単純性嚢腫7例、奇形腫6例、黄体化嚢腫4例、線維腫1例、間質性腫瘍1例、粘液性嚢胞腺腫1例、顆粒膜細胞腫1例、子宮神経芽腫1例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍1例、転移性ウィルムス腫瘍1例、性腺芽細胞腫1例が確認された。結論:本研究群ではねじれが最も多い診断で、通常は予測されていなかった。前思春期の卵巣手術では通常卵巣全体の摘出が行われた。しかし、この集団では悪性腫瘍は稀(9.6%)であるため、適切かつ技術的に可能な場合は嚢腫摘出術を考慮すべきである。
